title: skills.sh repo configuration
description: Local schema for skills.sh.json — controls how this repo's skills are grouped on its skills.sh page. Mirrors the fields documented at https://www.skills.sh/docs/customize. Maintained in-repo because skills.sh does not publish a referenceable schema.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor validation.

notGrouped.description: Where to place skills that aren't listed in any grouping. Defaults to bottom.

groupings.description: Ordered list of skill groups shown on the repo's skills.sh page.

description.description: Optional sub-text shown under the group title.

skills.description: Skill name slugs (the frontmatter `name`) belonging to this group.
